stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 57%/17%, Mr. Action Jackson 78%/41%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 84% / 52%, The Mahomies 29% / 4.5%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
⚡ Early edge: 49er Faith-Fool went from 42% to 56% against Kyle Tucker, led by Swift (3.50 pts).

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 66% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 38%).
📈 LINE MOVE: NYG @ IND: IND −2.5 at open, NYG −6 now. 6 league starters in it, led by C. Skattebo (Claremont In Yo Stace!).
🏟️ Game to watch: PHI @ DAL (Thursday 4:30 PM), 8 league starters in action with 119.84 pts up for grabs.
📰 Rams' Kam Kinchens ejected as hit leaves Packers' Christian Watson concussed. That's Brock You Like a Hurricane's WR. Developing.
👀 League gossip: TDsMaGee has 28.50 pts to play with against Brock You Like a Hurricane.
⚔️ Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson is projected to finish just 2.61 pts apart.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
